name: Richard Bennett
notes: The guitarist-producer of the Americana/neotraditional wing — the board behind Marty Stuart's and Steve Earle's records. The section's own scope note says why this entry looks the way it does: "in this archetype the producer role is largely occupied by instrumental specialists — the players whose parts are the train beat when there is no drum kit, and who also produce records. Each entry below is written as a parameter set for the part they contribute, because that is what the engine needs." His is the one entry here whose stated value is breadth rather than a fixed sound. The entry calls it "breadth of idiom" — the quoted phrase inside it, "encyclopedic knowledge of all kinds of roots and rock music," is Knopfler's, and the entry's own reading of it follows: "applied as period-accurate groove choice: rockabilly, Bakersfield, hillbilly-rock and folk-rock kits are all distinct presets he selects between rather than a single house sound". That is encoded as range rather than as `modes` — the parent genre already supplies three moods and authoring modes would delete them — so the drum block sits mid-scale with a `kick` range of [2,3] on anchors 1 and 3 and a mid `velocityTiers` spread, and the humanize block is the loosest of the stick-kit producers here (`quantizeStrength` 0.82, 6–7 ms jitter) because "period-authentic reverb and slapback rather than modern ambience" means a hand-played kit rather than a gridded one. The melody block is his signature and the entry is specific about it: "the electric-guitar intro as the record's identity ... Model a 4- or 8-bar composed electric intro figure, not a vamp." So `structure` is riff_loop with `phraseBars` weighted to 4 and 8, and the arrangement gives the intro a 4–8 bar span rather than the 2-bar cold opens its neighbours use. Harmony follows the stated production roster: "I–IV–V and I–V–vi–IV with modal ♭VII borrows and, on the Earle material, minor-mode and drone-based writing", hence the minor i–♭VII–IV family and a natural-minor scale weight. ⚠ INFERRED: `bpm.mode` 130 inside the stated 70–175 band, the velocity tiers, the −2 ms offset, `percs` contents and every countermelody and bassline number. ⚠ The entry rates itself medium with "groove specifics inferred from the roster [LOW-CONF]", and that flag applies to the whole drum block above; the sourced half is the roster, the era and the intro-figure detail.
